name: h
description: Portable pure-Kie batch and single-call workflow for image/video generation.

interface.shortDescription: Pure Kie batch or single-call image/video workflow with portable dependency bootstrap.
interface.longDescription: H runs Kie-only image and video workflows in two modes: batch processing for folders and single processing for one selected model call. It reverse-prompts through Kie multimodal text models, submits all eligible batch items concurrently, writes results to Desktop folders, and uses a plugin-local Python environment so the workflow can run on Windows and macOS without manual dependency setup.
defaultPrompt: Batch reverse and process PID product folders.
Generate videos from processed images with reverse prompts.
Run the full Kie product video workflow.
